visualize_densepose_results: visualize DensePose chart results on a BGR image using DensePoseResultsVisualizer
visualize_masked_colormap: visualize DensePose results with masked colormap overlay using DensePoseMaskedColormapResultsVisualizer
visualize_contour_mpl: visualize DensePose U/V contours on an image using DensePoseResultsMplContourVisualizer with matplotlib
visualize_contour_custom: visualize DensePose contours using marching squares via DensePoseResultsCustomContourVisualizer
visualize_fine_segmentation: visualize fine segmentation labels on an image using DensePoseResultsFineSegmentationVisualizer
